I fixed the typo in `services/notifier/migrations/202609011200_create_outbox.sql:4`. The column is now `recipient`.

I changed the migration file directly instead of adding a new one. The project has a general rule never to edit migrations that have been applied. A note specific to the notifier says its migrations haven't been applied to any shared database yet, and that until launch (planned for 2026-11) mistakes should be fixed in place. The general rule covers the top-level `migrations/` folder, which is already in production.

No other file in the repo uses `recipent`, so nothing else needed changing. If anyone has run this migration on their own local database, they'll need to recreate that database or rename the column by hand.
